name: Facet
text: Choose the *centered radial graph with scaled pulses*. It turns the entire interface into a living pulse of activity, making new data instantly visible while keeping the dark theme clean. The trade-off is slight visual clutter when many nodes pulse at once, but the gain in liveliness and clarity outweighs it—users spot changes faster than with static charts.

name: Pane
text: The radial graph’s pulses train users to ignore them—like a stock ticker they’ll learn to tune out. A static, color-coded intensity map keeps visibility high without the noise; settle it with a live A/B test measuring how often users notice new data in each version.
